candidates.description: This vector is related to Hindi script characters and sub-word tokens.
This vector is related to Hindi and Devanagari script characters and sub-word tokens.
This vector is related to Hindi script characters and phonetic sub-word tokens.
These tokens are Hindi dependent vowel signs and matras attached to consonants to form syllable blocks.
This vector activates for Brahmi-derived Indic script characters and vowel-modifier combinations, particularly involving the retroflex sibilant and vocalic r-marks.
This feature activates for subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari transliteration.
These tokens frequently appear as common subword units and prefixes within various Indic script words, particularly in Hindi and related languages.
This feature vector activates common Hindi verb roots and inflectional prefixes.
This vector represents the Hindi vowel sign 'aa' (matra ा) attached to various consonant glyphs.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi vowel signs and syllable combinations, particularly those involving 'e' and 'o' matras.
